title: NASim tiny public run plan
description: Authoring input for the admitted public NASim protocol. Carries the episode/turn/termination control and the descriptive stochastic controls that RAES SDL excludes. The stochastic controls are descriptive only: NASim binds action success through the global NumPy stream rather than the environment seed, so no executable random-stream binding is claimed and the determinism loss is retained.

episode_control.termination_rule: After each attacker step, evaluate independently: terminated when every sensitive host is compromised (goal reached), and truncated when the step count reaches the step limit (1000). The two boundaries are computed independently and reported separately.
episode_control.description: Source-native goal completion and the step-limit truncation stay distinct terminal causes.

stochastic_controls.description: The global NumPy seed 20260802 is the only stream that controls action success in the source; neither make_benchmark nor reset binds it for a static benchmark. Descriptive only; no executable binding.
The gym environment reset seed 20260802 seeds a stream NASim does not use to resolve action success for the static benchmark. Descriptive only; no executable binding.

validity_notes.note: Action success is drawn from the global NumPy RNG, not the gym reset seed; the determinism loss is retained as a non-claim.
